title: Placement Quest (Form B)
bigIdea: A parallel check-in used after a unit to measure what stuck. Same ideas as the first check-in, different questions. There is no pass or fail.

cards.title: A second check-in
cards.body: This is a placeholder Form B of the placement quest. It mirrors Form A's concepts so the team can compare before and after. Final questions land in a later content pass.

steps.prompt: Placeholder: which best describes a savings account that earns interest?

options.text: The bank pays you a little for keeping your money there
You pay the bank a monthly fee to hold your money
Your balance is guaranteed to double each year

steps.explanation: Placeholder item. Interest is money the bank pays you on your deposit.

steps.prompt: Placeholder: over many years, inflation tends to make the same money buy a little less.
steps.explanation: Placeholder item. Inflation is the slow rise in prices over time.

steps.prompt: Placeholder: owning a share of a company means you own what?

options.text: A small slice of that company
A loan the company must repay you
A lifetime discount on its products

steps.explanation: Placeholder item. A share is a small piece of ownership.

steps.prompt: Placeholder: a stock exchange is a marketplace where people buy and sell shares.
steps.explanation: Placeholder item. An exchange matches buyers and sellers of shares.

steps.prompt: Placeholder: in investing, what does "risk" usually mean?

options.text: The chance an investment loses value
A promise that you will earn money
The fee to open an account

steps.explanation: Placeholder item. Risk is the chance an investment loses value.

steps.prompt: Placeholder: an investment that could earn a lot usually carries a higher chance of loss too.
steps.explanation: Placeholder item. Higher possible reward tends to come with higher risk.
